sentences.text: This application for bail under Section 483 B.N.S.S. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.81/2024 registered at Police Station Jamsar, District Bikaner for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 447, 427, 379 & 120 of IPC.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the material available on record.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that even if the averments made in the FIR are taken at their face value, no specific offence is made out against the petitioner.
It was further contended that the petitioner had purchased the plot in question from one Poonama Ram and that he is a bona fide purchaser of the said land.

It was also submitted that the petitioner has been in judicial custody since 14.05.2025; no recovery is pending against [2025:RJ-JD:26887] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-6162/2025]
him, and the trial is likely to take a considerable period of time.
In these circumstances, it was prayed that the petitioner be released on bail.
4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the bail application.
Learned counsel for the complainant submitted that Poonama Ram was the ex-Sarpanch of the area in question and was well aware that the ownership of the plot had been transferred to another person.

It was further submitted that the petitioner and Poonama Ram Mahaveer Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:26887) on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155214101/
1 hatched a conspiracy in this regard.

entities.text: Poonama Ram Mahaveer Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:26887)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, it was argued that the petitioner does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.
5. Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that the main allegation has been levelled against the Poonama Ram.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
6. Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 B.N.S.S. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Mahaveer Singh S/o Bhim Singh arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.81/2024 registered at Police Station Jamsar, District Bikaner, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

(SANDEEP SHAH (VACATION JUDGE)),J 162-mohit/-
